results.description:
CJ Lomax is racing for everything she's ever wanted - a Cup Series contract that will prove she belongs at the top of the sport. She doesn't do distractions. She doesn't do charming men. And she has no patience for rivals. 

Then Grady McBane crashes into her world. 

With his career on the line and only one contract up for grabs, CJ should be nothing more than competition. Instead, he is drawn to her fire, her grit, and the sparks neither of them can ignore. 

As pressure mounts and the season heats up, the line between rivalry and desire disappears. 

For one of them to win, the other must lose - and falling for each other could cost them everything. 

"A Fast Woman" is a steamy rivals-to-lovers sports romance packed with fierce ambition, slow-burn tension, and high-speed chemistry. It is the first book in the Driven Women series.
